name: nGZSceneGraph::cDataListExtension::Create
notes: Lane OY (scenegraph D1a part 2): nGZSceneGraph::cDataListExtension is our class (src/sg/cDataListExtension.h): cExtension (lane OY) plus a counted cDataListItem list (lane OX) at +0x18, virtual bases cIExtension (+0x20, vtable 0xe7519c) and cIDataListExtension (+0x28, vtable 0xe7520c, 27 slots, its own vbptr +0x2c); size 0x30. A leaf: the COM factory 0xa990b0 (the only reference to the constructor) is hooked and every other function is in effect through callers. Tests (tests/sg_data_list_extension.cpp): DataListExtension_Slots (64 seeds x 48 ops through every face of a game-made and an our-made extension: every setter and getter, Remove/RemoveAll, QI, IsKindOf, the type name, GetDescription, Clone and the clone's own ops, GetTypeInfo eax, Write, and cExtension's owner / next / Connect / Notify / OnEvent / GetEventAttribute through the class's thunks; list items are real cDataListItems through a fake COM director), DataListExtension_ReadWrite (48 seeds: write, read into a fresh extension on each side, dump). Mutants: 53/55 killed, 2 argued equivalent (the destructor without RemoveAll, and RemoveAll removing index 0 each time: the list item is never handed out, so its own destruction releases the same items, and no test-visible step sits between the releases; notes/feedback/OY.md). Three survivors of the first run were killed after the Slots test began passing raw bool bytes (0 / 1 / 2 / 0x80) and starting most seeds named with a nested list over src/sg/cDataListExtension.{h,cpp}.
